items.title: 3 US AI Infrastructure Stocks Built For Data Center Demand
items.summary: AI infrastructure is where hot macro data meets real money at risk. Rate hike odds above 98% and sticky inflation are tightening the screws on valuations just as spending on data centers and chips sits in the spotlight. That mix can reward investors who are selective, not just bullish. This article walks through three AI infrastructure and data center builders exposed to the latest Fed driven news and explains why each might matter to your portfolio watchlist.
